Problem Statement

Why traditional cloud SIEM workflows fall short today.

01

Alert Fatigue from Log Volume

SOCs are flooded with millions of daily events across AWS, Azure, GCP and Okta — real threats get buried in noise from high false-positive rates.

02

Identity Drift & Credential Misuse

Over 80% of cloud breaches abuse valid credentials. Static rules can't establish per-user behavioural baselines to catch this.

03

No Blast Radius Visibility

Analysts can't quickly see how a compromised identity spreads through IAM roles, secrets, storage and databases.

04

Fragmented Log Inspection

Raw JSON logs require manual correlation against MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, and remediation steps — slow and error-prone.

Proposed Solution

A local-first Cloud Access Anomaly Detection & UEBA platform.

1

Unified Schema Normalization

Ingests raw AWS, Azure, GCP and Okta telemetry and standardizes it into one model (OCSF / ECS / CIM / KQL).

2

Behavioural Baselines & Sessionization

Builds 90-day mean/deviation baselines per user and flags 30-minute session spikes as true anomalies.

3

5-Hop Blast Radius Graph

Runs a recursive graph traversal over 1,050 entities and 2,593 relationships to score real downstream impact.

4

Explainable AI Root-Cause Engine

Turns every alert into a plain-English summary with MITRE ATT&CK mapping and D3FEND countermeasures.

Architecture Diagram

Enterprise 4-tier layered component architecture: from raw multi-cloud ingestion to explained, actionable alerts.

Implemented Features

What's already working in the current version of CAAD.

✓

Configurable Detection Rulebook

18 rules — 5 false-positive baselines and 13 threat anomaly rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

✓

Blast Radius Node Graph

Interactive Canvas visualizer showing 5-hop connections, edge labels and hover inspection.

✓

Baseline & Risk Matrix

Scatter plot mapping Risk Score vs Blast Radius across 4 threat quadrants.

✓

Analyst Feedback & Sentiment

Captures analyst comments, scores sentiment, and tracks a live User Satisfaction Index.

✓

Filter Exporter & Download Center

Exports filtered telemetry reports across 4 SIEM formats: OCSF, Sentinel KQL, Splunk CIM, Elastic ECS.

✓

Dark / Light SOC Theme

Full theme switcher between cyber-slate dark mode and a clean light mode.
